internal_only: CI fixture, not a product offering, and PERMANENTLY so — unlike qwen2.5-coder-0.5b, nothing here is pending retirement. The routing sentinel pulls a real catalog model on every PR across three operating systems, so it has to be small (708 MB) and it has to STOP: measured 2 tokens in 1.6s on a one-word prompt, where qwen3.5-0.8b produced 17,787 tokens in 58.5s and timed the boot benchmark out. Small and prompt is the whole job; its agent grade never was, and this sentence used to say the opposite. It claimed the model was clean on greeting and search — true of the three trials that had been run. At 24 it is greeting 0/24, read-file 3/24 and search-then-edit 13/24, a true per-call failure rate of at least 38% at 95% confidence (fixture 2004661dc908, agent 5de02987dc3e, nvidia-24gb-discrete, #479 re-measured under #483's grading). So a future CI leg that drives an actual tool call cannot be built on this model: it would lose over half its two-step requests. That rate is now printed on every agentgrade run (#484) — 38% against a 50% retirement line is the closest anything in the store has come, and a withheld entry's rate used to be printed nowhere. At 352M it produces nothing worth giving anyone, so it is withheld from every picker, catalog view and docs table while staying resolvable by id or alias.
